hook: WAITING TEN YEARS TO INVEST DOESN'T COST YOU THE SMALL YEARS.
hook_pattern: myth-correction (doesn't cost X, costs Y) + word-synced captions
metaphor: tree-trunk cross-section: one ring per invested year, ring area = balance

narration.script: Waiting ten years to invest doesn't cost you the small years. It costs you the biggest ones. Every year adds a ring. The last ten add more than the first thirty. Start now.

disclosures: $250/mo to age 65, 7%/yr average return assumed, compounded monthly
audio: voice + subtle SFX, no music (creator adds music per platform)
